notes.title: Parsing Raw Data: Creation of Boss
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ea9f5fcac15bd0f22c8f331ca047acb3dc2f6c11.jpg

Prior to Raw Data’s Early Access launch in July, people who experienced our original demo didn’t play as Bishop or Saija or any specific heroes at all, but a generic character with access to four weapons spawned from a central terminal: a 10mm pistol, energy katana, pump-action shotgun, and compound bow with incendiary arrows.

When Early Access launched with Bishop and Saija, we revealed our plan for the polished game featuring individual playable heroes each linked to a specific weapon: Bishop with his Crusader Pistols, Saija with her Flash Blade. Of course, that meant there were still two spots left, teased with silhouettes in the early user manual.

And after two months and three major content updates, the next operative to join SyndiK8’s elite team has arrived: Boss. However, despite his take-charge name and explosive Dominator Shotgun, Boss went through a long evolutionary process before bursting onto the scene as SyndiK8’s badass Street Merc.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/84f5326c3916c8d42360583be5847afd008c578f.jpg

When Boss was first conceptualized, he still fit the name, but “Mob Boss” might have been more fitting: the original concepts for the SyndiK8 heroes had them clad in business suits befitting of an Eden Corp executive, since the initial premise was infiltration from the inside. The shotgun had to have an appropriately heavy-hitting character to wield it, and the original model for Assault (as he was codenamed) more resembled a Bond villain’s strongman sidekick.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/7e4dff9073c7f6cddbae2e9d2e633ec585c2ed92.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b47d1fc092634334c92578e08533a3673aae6f63.jpg

However, as individual backstories were built out for each hero and the “Eden executive” disguise idea was dropped, it became clear that Boss was going to need a more unique aesthetic to match his history: he has a personal beef with Eden Corp because they’re directly responsible for the destruction of his family legacy. While he maintained his original role as the tank in SyndiK8’s elite lineup, his old mobster suit, polished shoes, and helmet-head weren’t going to be the right fit. (Of course, it's always possible that this initial design will resurface again in the future.)

With “techno-mercenary” as the new point of reference, Boss was completely reimagined as an anti-hero whose entire persona projects a simple message: don’t mess with me.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/336604488151d915face9bb5e1148f33f94b24e3.jpg

Okay, so it took a couple iterations for the suit to completely disappear, but it was promptly covered up by a leather trenchcoat that has persisted into the final design and become a favorite of the Raw Data costume closet.

First to go was the helmet, a central feature of the original design. When you’ve made a name for yourself as Neo-Shinjuku’s go-to gun for hire, you want your adversaries to know your face; hiding it behind a wall of metal would be cowardly. We paid homage to his original headgear with nanotech-enhanced tattoos wrapping around his head.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/240df184a9f15de1b607d8f44e209bf058169126.jpg

But an intimidating Street Merc has to be outfitted with some of the sweetest (and hardest-hitting) biotech available to show off his status, so while the helmet went by the wayside, the metal didn’t. It just shifted down to where it could pack the most punch, literally: his arms.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b69e5f19cf0ab5328e2f9829b31f1e2c7fc5bcec.jpg

Boss comes outfitted with a pair of Zaitomo bionic arms, a full shoulder-to-finger prosthetic that gives him extra strength and stability. These adamantium appendages allow him to fire his explosive Dominator Shotgun one-handed with little recoil and, when powered up, to deliver a knockout melee blow sure to shatter a synthetic’s jaw. (That latter feature requires a hardware upgrade that’s currently in development.)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/f084c10c0facdd51e64ffc303203944aa1b9850f.jpg

The Zaitomo arms also were the catalyst to cut the sleeves off Boss’s stylish trenchcoat, so he could show off his guns, both figuratively and literally. The coat was also left hanging open to display not the original suit and tie, but some badass form-fitting body armor befitting of his role as the frontline bullet sponge.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/051ec4c375f7f605e361d2954363caa749eb1500.jpg

Once those Zaitomo arms were installed and the trenchcoat hemmed, all that was needed was to revisit Boss’s weapon of choice and give it the appearance fitting of its moniker: the Dominator Shotgun.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/afb232a9df81bfa6efe3c60e5e889b166f05adac.jpg

Originally conceived as a modified shotgun swiped from Eden’s corporate arsenal--hence the sleek white and matte black finish--the Dominator now has a more natural color scheme befitting of its streetwise source, but with some personalized flair: its barrel sports laser etchings that echo Boss’s cranial tattoos.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/d68ebf351be1f9ebe1d6503a3333f25b79422ff2.jpg

The shotgun can also do a lot more now than just pop out shells, too. You can read Boss’s full ability rundown in our complete Boss hero spotlight), but all of his existing abilities revolve around the Dominator and its high-tech upgrades:

Nade Launcher enables the shotgun to launch up to three plasma grenades at a time, which are then slowly regenerated with no need for a physical reload.
Quad Chamber enables you to prime four shots with a single pump, reducing the need to pump the shotgun from 12 times per clip to three.
Air Juggle is an explosive AOE flak blast that hurls nearby enemies up into the air, leaving them suspended and helpless for a brief period.


And there’s a lot more of his abilities to come in future content updates, including his EXE ultimate ability Earthquake Slam, a passive upgrade for his Zaitomo arms that boosts his punching power, and an earth-shattering AOE.

His lone-wolf aura aside, Boss plays well with others--if they’re helping him get paid and take down Eden Corp, there’s no reason to make enemies of them. And when he’s back-to-back with either Bishop or Saija, an explosively good time is guaranteed...except maybe for Eden.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/95c8c9b4720dfafd483e188e527da678c03b3867.jpg

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.1 and 0.4.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks so much for all the feedback you've submitted on Raw Data Update 0.4--we've already been able to put together a couple hotfixes addressing some issues, which is now live!

Patch notes for Hotfix v.0.4.2 (released October 14):

Fixed a few more crash-causing issues.
Anti-aliasing setting temporarily disabled to guarantee optimal user experience (UI is still there).
Fixed an issue with graphics benchmarks affecting the resolution scaler multiplier (it’s now 1 by default). This should address some performance issues reported by users with non-standard display sizes.
Fixed a problem on clients with grenade firing mode getting stuck on Boss’ shotgun in high ping environments.
Disabled motion control late update because it was causing hand stutters for some users.
Audio will now maintain volume when application loses focus. This should address some issues reported by users who could not hear any audio after launching the game.


Patch notes for Hotfix 0.4.1 (released October 13):

Fixed several reported crashes.
Fixed issue with 2-handed Flash Blade grip.
Added force feedback and SFX for Boss's Proximity Reload.
Added a check on startup that unlocks the next mission in progression if the previous mission has been completed. This should keep players from having to replay Vapor Exploit to unlock the new Extermination mission.


Have fun, and don't forget to record your most badass Boss kills for our #PlayLikeABoss contest to win an Intel Core i7 processor!

New Enemy - Teleshifting Mekomo

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ebbf6c205d5c5ef5771564b737ff3f7dba5848d2.jpg

Death and Held Weapons - After dying, you’ll automatically respawn holding whatever weapon(s) you were holding prior to death, so you can get back into the fight faster!
Easy Difficulty - Easy Difficulty is more player-friendly overall with increased player health and damage, lowered volley shot count, and increased Data Core health. 
Hard and Nightmare Difficulties - Reduced Data Core health.
Mission Balance: Nuke Fusion - Waves have been rebalanced to smooth out difficulty, while the center beacon has been split into two (one for each lane) to improve map flow.
Mission Balance: Dark Source - Reduced enemy wave numbers.
Katana Throw Damage Trails - Saija’s Katana Throw now features light trails to visualize the amount of damage being dealt. This feature is not finished and is still under development.
Ability Balance: Katana Throw - Katana Throw’s distance and speed are now affected by actual throw speed. This feature is not finished and is still under development.
Charged Shot VFX - Bishop's Crusader Pistol now shakes slightly when charging up. Additionally, visual recoil when firing Charged Shot (one hand) or Fusion Shot (both hands) has been increased.
UI Scrolling - You can now scroll through UI scroll lists by pointing at it with your dominant hand and swiping your thumb on the touchpad.

PERFORMANCE/STABILITY

As we continue to refine our performance benchmarks and machine configurations, please note that your graphics settings will be automatically reset with this update.


Main Menu - In game UI has been significantly optimized to minimize CPU load
Controller Latency - Motion controller update has been implemented to minimize hand-tracked latency. If you bring up the SteamVR compositor and move your hands, you should now see negligible delay between the SteamVR controller model and your avatar hands.
Matchfinding - Optimization to Matchfinding avatars to reduce CPU load.
Interaction Overlaps - Player interaction overlaps have been refactored to improve CPU performance.
Animation Logic - Player and AI animation logic have been adjusted for CPU performance.
Visual Optimizations - Various FX and material optimizations for GPU performance.
Stability - Various crash and stability improvements across the board.



FIXES

Friendlists - Fixed an issue where large steam friendlists would cause intermittent slow downs.
Voice Chat - Fixed an issue that caused voice chat to work intermittently.
Voice Sync - Fixed an issue where voice chat could lose sync and play 5-10 seconds delayed.
Mute - Fixed an issue where the “Mute outgoing voice” option was non-functional.
Progression - Fixed a potential non-progression issue in Vapor Exploit mission.
Windows N Intro Bypass - Added functionality to allow users on Windows N (Anniversary update) who are lacking the proper Windows Media Player components to progress past the Survios intro movie.
Leaderboards - Fixed an issue where users could encounter a freeze when switching leaderboards.
Scores - Fixed an issue in Leaderboards where the same score would be displayed every 10 ranks.
Stuck Hands - Fixed an issue where players could get both hands stuck to their gun with the sticky control scheme.
Graphic Settings - Fixed an issue where graphics settings were not resetting properly.
Beam - Fixed an issue where Beam Mekomo laser beam impact effect would persist on death.
Jitter - Fixed an issue where Beam Mekomo would jitter while moving on ramps.
Mega Mekomo - Fixed an issue where Mega Mekomo would not attack the Data Core.
Ground Attacks - Fixed an issue where ground Mekomos could perform melee attacks against the Data Core while not in range.
HMD Buffer - Fixed an issue where the HMD buffer size was tied to window mirror size.

Join us on the Steam discussion forum and engage with developers and fellow SyndiK8 operatives, and be sure to use the official Feedback Form and Bug Reporting Form to submit anything you encounter.

Good luck–we look forward to reviewing your latest reports, especially from those of you opting to team up with Boss!

notes.title: Hero Spotlight: Boss, the Street Merc
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/9ec927c08fdd7112da74d08659592ac4e6b9bcbf.jpg

Hello, and welcome to the third Raw Data hero spotlight! In this series, we’ll give you insight into how SyndiK8’s top operatives utilize nanotechnology to gain enhanced abilities, both through their weapons and with their minds.

By now, you’ve all had almost three months to perfect your pistols as Bishop or hone your blade as Saija--but the dynamic duo is about to become a trio. Raw Data Early Access Update 0.4 arrives next week, and it introduces the first new playable hero since launch: Boss the Street Merc.

You got the initial hints at his abilities in last week’s Sneak Peek, but now it’s time to formally make his acquaintance.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/edd8489644cc3ebb767379ed4b7c99fe5d9d2c7f.jpg

Boss brings a ton of firepower to the fight against Eden Corp thanks to a pump-action shotgun that launches both heavy-duty shells and plasma grenades.

And while his intimidating presence--especially those Zaitomo bionic arms--paints him as an antihero loner, Boss is quickly becoming SyndiK8’s top op to send out as half of a pair: his skills are perfectly complimented by a partner’s special abilities.


This is My Boomstick

After Bishop’s pistols and Saija’s katana, the next weapon we had to bring in was the appropriately-named Dominator Shotgun, so named because it owns anyone unfortunate enough to be caught in its sights.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/16771ab455ec9f51c17e83ef97424c3b283c8c58.gif

The shotgun is made to blow away whatever it crosses, but with great power comes great...endurance. You can grab and fire with just your dominant hand, but you’ll need both to prime each shot: although the Dominator’s clip holds 12 shells, you need to pump the shotgun between each shot.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dceac73cdbf6d92a13536f3e227cc0d75b00d08e.gif

As you complete missions with Boss, you’ll unlock more shotgun upgrades. Quad Chamber reduces the need to pump the shotgun to every four shots, giving your arm a break. And there’s Proximity Reload, which is similar to Bishop’s ability of the same name: you can automatically reload the shotgun simply by touching it to your shoulder, without having to grab a clip.


Blow Us All Away

The Dominator Shotgun doesn’t just fire shells. It’s also got a few tricks up its barrel in the form of powerful plasma grenades that will obliterate any enemies in your path.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/637d6c61bcaa21070e4d7e83927333ebd27a240e.gif

Pull the non-dominant Trigger to fire up to three grenades in a row. They’ll ricochet off any nearby solid surfaces and explode after a couple seconds of travel time. And the best part? There’s no need to reload grenades since they’re on a cooldown. Keep track of how many grenades are available on the cooldown display on the side of Boss’s shotgun, but be aware: these take time to regenerate, and they’re most effective (and destructive) when deployed more than one at a time.


Get Some Air

Boss comes into Update 0.4 with one weapon-based special ability, and it’s one your SyndiK8 teammate is sure to enjoy. Air Juggle is an explosive AOE flak blast that hurls nearby enemies up into the air.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/112e40089fffa5cf676873a8d7171687c1d983d5.gif

Activate Air Juggle by pressing down and swiping left on dominant controller’s trackpad, then sit back and laugh as it turns Eden Corp synthetics into clay pigeons for Bishop’s Bulletstorm, Saija’s Katana Throw, and, of course, Boss’s Dominator. Who’s up for some target practice?!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/261dac0b1b533b1c1d53abac05e2d6240c236bd4.gif

In a future update, Air Juggle will also meet its perfect ability partner: Boss’s EXE Ultimate Earthquake Slam. We can’t reveal specifics yet, but let’s just say that what goes up must come down--and this landing is anything but soft.


C’mon, Take a Shot

Between his crazy shotgun and biomech upgrades, Boss is truly an unstoppable force and an incredible asset to SyndiK8’s ops team. But with slower reload and firing speeds and a grenade cooldown, his firepower comes at a slight price. It all balances out.

That’s why he fares best in a pair, trading shots with Bishop or lining up enemies for Saija to slice while keeping them from getting overwhelmed. And when Boss decides those robots need some airtime, everybody wins.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ab2d4017fd64346b11529926e2b1afb710f15d0d.gif

And with Boss on your team, ability combos just got that much more explosive:


Air Juggle + Grenades: toss some into the airborne fray and enjoy the fireworks
Air Juggle + Charged Shot/Bullettime/Bulletstorm (Bishop): pop enemies up into the air, then slow time down for you each to take your best pot shots
Air Juggle + Katana Throw/Shuriken Stream (Saija): the Cyber Ninja will thank you for giving her boomerang so many ‘bots to slice through
Grenade + Teleshift + Shotgun: send an enemy staggering with a well-aimed grenade, then rush forward to deliver a satisfyingly literal final blow


After a few successful missions, you’ll deliver a solid message to Eden Corp: you’re not the Boss of me now.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/71debb23c0d30229ec4486229e9c21dd46acb957.gif

Oh, and the best part about Boss? This isn’t it--he’s got way more badass abilities on the way in future updates, including an upgrade for those metallic muscles that will give him some serious punching power.

The shotgun is made to blow away whatever it crosses, but with great power comes great...endurance. You can grab and fire with just your dominant hand, but you’ll need both to prime each shot: although the Dominator’s clip holds 12 shells, you need to pump the shotgun between each shot.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dceac73cdbf6d92a13536f3e227cc0d75b00d08e.gif

As you complete missions with Boss, you’ll unlock more shotgun upgrades. Quad Chamber reduces the need to pump the shotgun to every four shots, giving your arm a break. And there’s Proximity Reload, which is similar to Bishop’s ability of the same name: you can automatically reload the shotgun simply by touching it to your shoulder, without having to grab a clip.


Blow Us All Away

The Dominator Shotgun doesn’t just fire shells. It’s also got a few tricks up its barrel in the form of powerful plasma grenades that will obliterate any enemies in your path.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/637d6c61bcaa21070e4d7e83927333ebd27a240e.gif

Pull the non-dominant Trigger to fire up to three grenades in a row. They’ll ricochet off any nearby solid surfaces and explode after a couple seconds of travel time. And the best part? There’s no need to reload grenades since they’re on a cooldown. Keep track of how many grenades are available on the cooldown display on the side of Boss’s shotgun, but be aware: these take time to regenerate, and they’re most effective (and destructive) when deployed more than one at a time.


Get Some Air

Boss comes into Update 0.4 with one weapon-based special ability, and it’s one your SyndiK8 teammate is sure to enjoy. Air Juggle is an explosive AOE flak blast that hurls nearby enemies up into the air.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/112e40089fffa5cf676873a8d7171687c1d983d5.gif

Activate Air Juggle by pressing down and swiping left on dominant controller’s trackpad, then sit back and laugh as it turns Eden Corp synthetics into clay pigeons for Bishop’s Bulletstorm, Saija’s Katana Throw, and, of course, Boss’s Dominator. Who’s up for some target practice?!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/261dac0b1b533b1c1d53abac05e2d6240c236bd4.gif

In a future update, Air Juggle will also meet its perfect ability partner: Boss’s EXE Ultimate Earthquake Slam. We can’t reveal specifics yet, but let’s just say that what goes up must come down--and this landing is anything but soft.


C’mon, Take a Shot

Between his crazy shotgun and biomech upgrades, Boss is truly an unstoppable force and an incredible asset to SyndiK8’s ops team. But with slower reload and firing speeds and a grenade cooldown, his firepower comes at a slight price. It all balances out.

That’s why he fares best in a pair, trading shots with Bishop or lining up enemies for Saija to slice while keeping them from getting overwhelmed. And when Boss decides those robots need some airtime, everybody wins.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/ab2d4017fd64346b11529926e2b1afb710f15d0d.gif

And with Boss on your team, ability combos just got that much more explosive:


Air Juggle + Grenades: toss some into the airborne fray and enjoy the fireworks
Air Juggle + Charged Shot/Bullettime/Bulletstorm (Bishop): pop enemies up into the air, then slow time down for you each to take your best pot shots
Air Juggle + Katana Throw/Shuriken Stream (Saija): the Cyber Ninja will thank you for giving her boomerang so many ‘bots to slice through
Grenade + Teleshift + Shotgun: send an enemy staggering with a well-aimed grenade, then rush forward to deliver a satisfyingly literal final blow


After a few successful missions, you’ll deliver a solid message to Eden Corp: you’re not the Boss of me now.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/71debb23c0d30229ec4486229e9c21dd46acb957.gif

Oh, and the best part about Boss? This isn’t it--he’s got way more badass abilities on the way in future updates, including an upgrade for those metallic muscles that will give him some serious punching power.

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/3f0cd8ce256860957225ddc4f8bda237b70251f6.jpg

Greetings, SyndiK8 ops!

As we disclosed last week, thanks to your efforts, we’ve extracted tons of valuable information with regards to Eden Corp’s digital infrastructure. What does that mean for you? Two new missions, two new opportunities to extract more of that sweet, sweet raw data.

However, Eden’s security system is getting a bit paranoid, so their protocols have been--shall we say--heightened a bit.


New Mission: Thundershock

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/dfaaddda631eed1222a8b81c7f4b88153782475a.jpg

Eden’s robotics facilities and fusion reactor are going crazy trying to keep up with all of the damage you’ve inflicted. While it’s great that we’re overloading their systems, it’s had an unexpected side effect: seems all that excess electrical energy have reacted with the solar winds in the atmosphere to generate a perfect storm.

Make your way across the Eden rooftop, but be wary of those brutal lightning strikes. While they’ll hit you like a ton of bricks, the robots seem almost--rejuvenated. So be sure to dodge the elements while also quickly taking out any enemies revitalized by the surge.


New Mission: Extermination

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8b38f08fe1041235a0fab7eeaace4f21d55312de.jpg

Survived the strikes? Then it’s time to descend into the ancient (by Eden standards) Teleshift laboratory, where the technology was first devised--and where nobody’s set foot since it was mysteriously sealed up tight.

Except you, of course. And apparently there’s some sort of old “Extermination Protocol” in place that’ll probably be triggered, and if I know these older setups, that can only mean one thing: lasers. Lots and lots of advanced security lasers. Hope you’re ready for some dancing, because these will put your dexterity to the test…


...Hold up. I just got an urgent transmission.

It sounds like we’ve got something else to share, but I’ve got to review some files first. I’ll check back in with you soon...

Stay tuned for Part 2, coming later this week!

notes.title: Raw Data Update 0.3 Now Live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/45d872adee27889080d951939ca4b3c7ee6dfcfa.jpg

Greetings, SyndiK8 operatives!

The data we’ve been collecting from your ventures into Eden Corp have been invaluable. Thanks to your ongoing feedback and reports, we’ve been able to put together our next big update for your mission.

For one, Mission Control has managed to get you access to a completely new area of Eden, and inside you’ll encounter two new enemies standing between you and your mission objective…

Here’s what’s just been implemented in Raw Data:

New Content & Features

New Mission - Nuke Fusion

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/84fb257603e051094c94c43df7ae87b9ea068d52.jpg

Experience an all-new Data Chamber-centric area of Eden Corp. Shoot enemies and dodge death beams as you teleshift across precarious platforms, all radiating from the massive reactor powering Eden’s facilities.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/f1ed9545ec36bede63646b5ec757cce7f03cc6c7.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/1f3926250575e12a3b8f26c51ecb7d0000c7b667.gif
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/08046f12ad2929c7395bea10f4df18d74c213c76.gif


New Enemy - Mega Dynomo

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/b369136c7a802766976a0ceae4a350c776f72bbb.gif

Dynomos aren’t the heaviest bots that Eden manufactures. With your continuous disruptions of their plan, they had to bring out the big guns–literally.

Meet the Mega Dynomo: your encounter with him is certain to be smashing. (Pro tip: if you don’t want to deal with the Mega, take out those bots booking it to the reactor!)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/7f170e882109de8f7d918ac5a37fd2d93c40d319.jpg

New Enemy – Beamfire Mekomo
The upgraded model of the Burstfire Mekomo (of which you’ve already destroyed hundreds) fires solid plasma energy beams with far greater accuracy than its spray-and-pray brethren.

New Defense – Plasma Turret
Turrets: they’ve always got your back. Now you can get an even more powerful version that eschews lasers in favor of plasma-powered directed-energy beams.

New Feature – Rack-Up Screen
Once you’re back in the showroom after completing a mission, aNg3L will share a Data Link displaying your total uploaded raw data, mission scores, Crypto currency rewards, and available unlocked technologies–a.k.a. everything you need to know.

New Feature – Difficulty System
Whether you go it alone or team up with a fellow operative, now you can adjust how hard-hitting Eden’s security system handles your infiltration. There’s even a Nightmare mode for those daring (or foolish) enough to face a truly brutal challenge…

New Feature – Leaderboards
Think you’re the top of SyndiK8’s rankings? Now you can find out for sure with official Raw Data global rankings for individual players! (Note: leaderboards will be periodically cleared throughout Early Access period.)

New Feature – Multiplayer Quickplay
Teaming up is now easier! What are you waiting for? Humanity depends on you!


Gameplay Improvements/Balance

Cloak Tekomo Improvements – The Cloak Tekomo (“Ninja Bot”) has been gotten a software upgrade with new advanced dodging, cloaking, and combo mechanics. If you sense his presence, be sure to protect your turrets.

Saija Buff – Saija has received various buffs to her stats and abilities across the board that should make her more competitive with Bishop’s damage output.

Cooldown Audio – Added a sound effect to indicate when ability cooldowns have refreshed.


Fixes

Mission Return – When you return to the showroom after a mission, the main menu now defaults to the level select screen if you are the game host or are a single player.

Multiplayer Launch – It is no longer possible to launch a multiplayer game with only one player in the lobby.

Sky Push – As Bishop, it is no longer possible to get into a state where the player character is continuously pushed upward toward the sky.

Gun Loss – The user is no longer able to lose access to one of their guns using toggle/hold controls by dropping guns after firing a Fusion Shot.


Known Issues: We are investigating these issues and hope to have fixes for these soon. If you encounter any of these, please help us by reporting the issue ( Bug Report Form)

    In multiplayer, some users may encounter an issue where either the host or client can lose voice chat while transitioning between levels. Restarting the application should restore voicechat functionality.
    When loading into Mission 4 - Nuke Fusion, the client has a small chance of crashing. Please submit any crash reports that are generated from this.
    Spamming the different Leaderboard lists (especially those without scores) has the potential to freeze the game. 
    There is a potential non-progression issue in Vapor Exploit on higher difficulties. Be sure to search the map carefully for any stuck bots. Screenshots of stuck bots are especially helpful with these issues.
    Nitromo enemies can sometimes push players through level geometry when exploding, preventing them from being able to move. 


And as always, we want to hear your ongoing thoughts on how we can better support your mission into Eden Corp! Join us on the  Steam discussion forum and engage with developers and fellow SyndiK8 operatives, and be sure to use the official  Feedback Form and  Bug Reporting Form to submit anything you encounter.

Good luck–we look forward to reviewing your latest reports!

Signing off,

Spencer

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/7f170e882109de8f7d918ac5a37fd2d93c40d319.jpg

New Enemy – Beamfire Mekomo
The upgraded model of the Burstfire Mekomo (of which you’ve already destroyed hundreds) fires solid plasma energy beams with far greater accuracy than its spray-and-pray brethren.

New Defense – Plasma Turret
Turrets: they’ve always got your back. Now you can get an even more powerful version that eschews lasers in favor of plasma-powered directed-energy beams.

New Feature – Rack-Up Screen
Once you’re back in the showroom after completing a mission, aNg3L will share a Data Link displaying your total uploaded raw data, mission scores, Crypto currency rewards, and available unlocked technologies–a.k.a. everything you need to know.

New Feature – Difficulty System
Whether you go it alone or team up with a fellow operative, now you can adjust how hard-hitting Eden’s security system handles your infiltration. There’s even a Nightmare mode for those daring (or foolish) enough to face a truly brutal challenge…

New Feature – Leaderboards
Think you’re the top of SyndiK8’s rankings? Now you can find out for sure with official Raw Data global rankings for individual players! (Note: leaderboards will be periodically cleared throughout Early Access period.)

New Feature – Multiplayer Quickplay
Teaming up is now easier! What are you waiting for? Humanity depends on you!

Multiplayer Launch – It is no longer possible to launch a multiplayer game with only one player in the lobby.

Sky Push – As Bishop, it is no longer possible to get into a state where the player character is continuously pushed upward toward the sky.

notes.title: Parsing Raw Data: Creation of Saija
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/0b99eb39da85dfba181cbe4d4544c3529d81a9de.jpg

You’ve  met Bishop, and earlier you got an in-depth look at all of Saija’s gravity-manipulation abilities that make her so much more than just a melee class. Just like with Bishop, we wanted to share our inspiration for Raw Data’s distinctive take on the classic ninja archetype, playing with how she would embody the well-honed tropes while also standing out as a unique interpretation.

She’s also become such an iconic figure for us during development that we made her the star of Raw Data’s cover art.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8876b6023f3a408d455da7bfb2f2db1bda4b2c67.jpg

The concept of a tech-enhanced ninja is so well-suited to Raw Data’s futuristic Neo-Shinjuku setting that it was basically part of the game from the start. Even the earliest demos of the game featured the fan-favorite Flash Blade, because--simply put--everyone feels badass wielding a katana.

But our ninja needed to be much more than just a martial artist clad in black. You’ve probably already noticed that Saija sports a bit more armor than her gun-wielding compatriot.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/63fd9b526ae9d3d638d00eaf04606681e4a3a610.jpg

As one of SyndiK8’s elite operatives, Saija walks the line between being a spy in the shadows and a fighter on the front lines: a marriage of the ancient discipline of  Ninjutsu with the samurai code of  Bushido. In the Raw Data universe, Ninjutsu has evolved to stand toe-to-toe with advanced weaponry by including mental mastery among its practices.

Along with refined swordplay and incredible physical prowess, practitioners of modern Ninjutsu are also telekinetic thanks to point-cloud neural nanomachines. How can a gun compete with someone who’s able to not only deflect the bullet, but pick up the shooter and fling him away?

During the concept art process, Saija wasn’t even referred to as a ninja--her codename was “Knight,” and with her suit of futuristic armor, it wasn’t that far-fetched of a moniker.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/407787c0824deb0c8f1e0194e71cde1510fa54e5.jpg

In a sharp contrast to Bishop, Saija is completely shielded from head to toe in form-fitting armor that explicitly reads as such. It needed to be equal parts protective and agile, so we went for a chitinous appearance that suggests interlocking yet flexible plates of carbon fiber and strong vinyl.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/8f43566c72a5e2bd05d5ec836bf14b518e302de1.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/36c203064e4232d9a73ed5d50c717c7f8905f789.jpg

Saija’s suit also gained a helmet for complete head coverage, transforming her into the consummate faceless assassin.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/695ccf7856f4ad2c9fbfc4fdeee78fe84cd54ac8.jpg

A basic katana wouldn’t cut it (literally), so Saija uses the latest in blade-honing technology. Her retractable energy-powered Flash Blade features an advanced harmonizing wave-dynamic effector grind, providing sharpness on an atomic scale. In simple terms: it slices through everything unfortunate enough to come into contact with it.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/bd661e4370152e318282c8e2a711eb07d5ca2d33.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/67fe9445ac44196bd188c01e37b167360bf83c3f.gif

As mentioned before, while Saija is easy to classify as a melee hero because of her Flash Blade, her true strength lies in that perfect balance of physical and mental power. Playing as Saija means you have to always be aware of positioning (Teleshift is essential), plan your ability timing well, and not be afraid to get up close and personal with Eden’s vicious synthetics (read the full ability rundown in  our complete Saija hero feature):

     Katana Throw transforms the Flash Blade into a ranged weapon: a sharp spinning boomerang with a controllable flight path that slices through enemies both going and coming.
     Gravity Thrust unleashes a wave of energy that can knock enemies backward, shove them aside, or even yank them forward for when you’re feeling particularly stabby.
     Levitation Smash, Saija’s ultimate, lets you rise above the battle--then come crashing back down with a devastating energy blast in all directions.


Saija is a challenge to play, but there’s a reason she’s the go-to hero on the Survios dev team. (See their tips and tricks for playing both her and Bishop!) With her gravity-defying telekinetic abilities and kickass blade, Raw Data’s Cyber Ninja adds a new level of adrenaline to VR gameplay. Choose Saija for your SyndiK8 team and experience how it feels to cut down your enemies, see them strewn before you, and hear the sizzling death knells of robots forcefully powering down.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/33b9eca84d7a3d03b9d4b4496dd3a5d3b2e9bb76.jpg

notes.title: Raw Data Now Live on Steam Early Access! + Roadmap
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12632797/59b38ba3d21e081cf17ed483e5c58f372f94e820.jpg

Thank you everyone for all the positive feedback about Raw Data in the last few months!  We are thrilled to finally bring you the first public build of Raw Data. Launch day packs a ton of features, and we will be constantly updating the game with more missions, enemies, heroes, weapons, defenses, and tons more throughout Early Access and beyond. 

Here’s a quick snapshot of what is available to play starting now for Early Access v0.1:

 Online Co-op! Battle against killer death machines together in VR, over a network
 Starting Hero: Bishop, the Gun Cleric
 New Weapon: Crusader Pistol
 Starting Hero: Saija, the Cyber Ninja
 New Weapon: Flash Blade
 Special Abilities for Bishop: Charged Shot, Timewarp, Proximity Reload, Dual Wield, Bullet Storm
 Special Abilities for Saija: Shuriken Stream, Reflection Counter, Katana Throw, Gravity Thrust, Levitation Smash
 New Map: Eden Showroom, where you can join up with friends, browse your main menu, and practice with gameplay tutorials.
 New Mission: Hard Point, the first sector in Eden Tower you visit as a part of Simon’s “investor tour”
 New Mission: Dark Source, a 100-year-old abandoned robotics laboratory with a dark past
 New Mission: Skybound, located in a shipping harbor with some very deadly cargo
 New Mission: Vapor Exploit, where a dense fog shrouds one of Eden Corp’s largest skyports
 Nine Enemy Types: Walkers (Rigid Automo), Runners (Nimble Automo), Exploders (Nitromo), Jumping Crawler, Rocket Mechs (Military Dynomo), Charging Mechs (Industrial Dynomo), Flying Drones (Hornet), Laser Bots (Burstfire Mekamo)
 One Defense Type: Laser Turrets
 Tutorials for Pistol, Melee, Data Core and one "goof around area"


In addition, we are sharing our current plan for the Raw Data Roadmap throughout Early Access. We will be continually pushing updates and bug fixes to the game, with new features launching every two weeks. Keep in mind, a big part of the development of Raw Data is the response, feedback, and ideas from players. Based on this we may change priorities, modify release cadence, or add/remove features to improve the game. Balance adjustments and specific fixes are not detailed here, but will happen continuously throughout Early Access as well.

Early Access v0.2

 New unlockable special ability for Bishop: Fusion Charged Shot
 New unlockable special ability for Saija: Telekinesis
 Locomotion system update, with ability to change direction mid-dash
 Improved Enemy AI pathing system


Early Access v0.3

 New Mission: Nuke Fusion
 New Enemy type
 Rack up screen and updated scoring system
 New Leaderboards System
 New Difficulty System with multiple options


Early Access v0.4

 Two new Deployable Defense types
 New Boosts System, accessible via the replicator touch screen menu
 Pioneer perks released for Early Access players
 New Mission
 Two new weapon accessories for Boosts system
 New Weapon: Plasma Grenades
 New Enemy type


Early Access v0.5

 New Hero: The Street Merc
 New Special Abilities for Street Merc
 New Weapon: Dominator Shotgun
 Two new Missions
 New Enemy type


Early Access v0.6

 Three new Defense types
 New tutorials
 New Special Ability for Street Merc
 Two new Items for Boosts system


Early Access v0.7

 Two new Missions
 New Hero: The Rogue Hunter
 New Special Abilities for Rogue Hunter
 New Weapon: Viper Bow
 New Challenges System
 New tutorials


Early Access v0.8

 Three new Defense types
 New special ability for Rogue Hunter
 Two new Items for Boosts System


Early Access v0.9
[to be announced!]

Raw Data v1.0
[to be announced!]


Finally, here is a short list of known issues to be aware of:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/436320/discussions/2/366298942103430286/


We are looking forward to the journey ahead with all of you!

The Survios Team
